summary: ish_hosttest.c, built over the C library and with ISH_RAW_HOSTTEST, with eight faults in private copies of ish/ish.c and ish/ish_cstring_utilities.c; the test includes ish.c by a path relative to itself, so the build copies the test, ishmusl.c and ish/ under the work directory, and the test runs both programs, prefixing each line with the program's mode and ending with its status

argv: set -e; rm -rf ${WORK}/b; mkdir -p ${WORK}/b/tests/host ${WORK}/b/tests/musl; cp -R ish ${WORK}/b/ish; cp ${SRC}/ish/ish.c ${WORK}/b/ish/ish.c; cp ${SRC}/ish/ish_cstring_utilities.c ${WORK}/b/ish/ish_cstring_utilities.c; cp tests/host/ish_hosttest.c ${WORK}/b/tests/host/; cp tests/musl/ishmusl.c ${WORK}/b/tests/musl/; for mode in libc raw; do extra=; [ $mode != raw ] || extra=-DISH_RAW_HOSTTEST; ${CC:-cc} -std=c99 -D_DEFAULT_SOURCE -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=0 -DRACH2_HOSTTEST -DISH_USE_STDLIB $extra -g -O1 -Wno-empty-body -ffreestanding -fsanitize=address,undefined -fno-sanitize-recover=all -I rach2/sys -I rach2/sys/lib -I rach2/sys/proc -I utils -I krffs -I tests/host/compat ${WORK}/b/tests/host/ish_hosttest.c ${WORK}/b/ish/ish_shell_utilities.c ${WORK}/b/ish/ish_cstring_utilities.c -o ${WORK}/ish_hosttest.$mode; done

st=0; for mode in libc raw; do s=0; ${WORK}/ish_hosttest.$mode >${WORK}/ish.$mode.out 2>&1 || s=$?; sed "s/^/$mode: /" ${WORK}/ish.$mode.out; echo "$mode: status $s"; [ $st -ne 0 ] || st=$s; done; exit $st

faults.name: interrupted
faults.summary: a wait that an interrupted call ends early

faults.name: chunks
faults.summary: each read run as one line, not split at its newlines

faults.name: partial
faults.summary: a line split across short reads begun again at each read

faults.name: eof
faults.summary: a final line with no newline dropped

faults.name: overflow
faults.summary: a line too long run when its newline arrives

faults.name: path
faults.summary: a candidate path cut at its limit still tried

faults.name: join
faults.summary: a path cut at its limit reported as whole

lines: libc: ISHMUSL FAIL (path joined past its limit)
raw: ISHMUSL FAIL (path joined past its limit)
